notes.title: Version 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Good afternoon! Welcome to the development team Hentai EroCum!

Today became available the first version of our game, which you can buy now and the first week at a discount!

We made some last minute changes based on feedback from respected curators:
[list]
[*] Added ability to adjust music sound in game
[*] Possibility of correct exit in menu and exit the game with "Escape" key
[*] Changed the order of image themes
[*] Small edits
[/list]

We plan to release a patch containing higher resolution images, as well as edits based on first user feedback.

In addition, we plan to release a free update containing an additional location created based on the wishes of our players. Your wishes regarding location themes and pictures you can leave in corresponding discussion section of our community :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549672/96a2222ca2002433f4d110a59452bdf30f8bf6fc.png[/img]

We thank everyone who supported us and we will try to improve what we have now and give you more good emotions and beautiful girls)

Thank you very much, have a good day and weekend!

- Hentai EroCum development team
- Deni_Sele

notes.title: Game release tomorrow!
notes.notes:
Hentai EroCum will be released tomorrow, February 24th, Friday.

Uncovering our last two puzzle themes: the office and public transport. The further away, the hotter the images :)

Within a week after the release we plan to update the game with major fixes and add your suggestions. We will also add images in higher resolution (1k -> 2k).
And also announce a special surprise for all those who have bought the game.

Thanks to everyone who supported us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43549672/c9a5f980b0fb796afa8727bce48db8e2f753a6c3.png[/img]

- Hentai EroCum development team
